主要内容: Geospace Technologies Corporation, a Delaware corporation, completed its reincorporation in the State of Texas from the State of Delaware on April 16, 2015. The reincorporation was executed through a merger with Texas Geospace Technologies Corporation, a newly formed subsidiary. The merger was approved by shareholders at the 2015 Annual Meeting on February 12, 2015. The Company ceased to exist as a separate entity, with Texas Geospace as the surviving entity. The reincorporation did not alter shareholder ownership, CUSIP, trading symbol, or business operations. All shares were converted into Texas Geospace common stock, and prior shares were cancelled. GEOSPACE TECHNOLOGIES CORP changed its state of incorporation from Delaware to Texas on April 16, 2015, pursuant to the Merger Agreement. The Company's rights of stockholders are now governed by the Texas Business Organizations Code and the Amended and Restated Certificate of Formation and Bylaws adopted under the Merger Agreement.
